name: Berlin Christmas Markets Tour
description: Orientation tour across Berlin's most festive markets, peppered with stories of German Christmas customs, hand-crafted gifts and seasonal treats.

name: Christmas Market Tour with Mulled Wine
description: A compact evening combo: city sightseeing on the walk, finishing with a tumbler of mulled wine at one of Berlin's Christmas markets.

name: Private Christmas Market Tour
description: A private two-hour guided stroll through Berlin's best-loved Christmas markets, for groups of up to fifteen.

name: Christmas Lights Bus Tour incl. Mulled Wine
description: An atmospheric evening coach ride through Christmas-lit Berlin, with festive commentary and a stop to warm up at a market.

name: Tour of Lights with Photo Stops
description: A live-guided evening tour hunting down Berlin's most dazzling light displays, with stops for the perfect photo.

name: Evening River Spree Cruise at Christmastime
description: Two hours gliding the heated Spree past Museum Island and the Government Quarter, all dressed in festive light.

name: Tannenduft & Lichterglanz Solar Catamaran Tour
description: A solar-powered catamaran carrying you along the illuminated waterways on a leisurely two-and-a-half hour sightseeing glide.

name: Christmas Boat Trip with Mulled Wine
description: A cosy winter cruise combining city views with hot mulled wine and pastries served on board.

name: Christmas Garden Berlin
description: The Botanical Garden transformed into an illuminated fairytale: light arenas, luminous trees and a glowing trail winding through the beds.

name: Christmas at Tierpark
description: Friedrichsfelde's zoo in full festive dress: glowing art installations, winter stalls and animals in the cold-season calm.

name: Advent Concert at the Berlin Philharmonic
description: Seasonal classical works in the warm acoustic of the Philharmonie's Chamber Music Hall - a calm island inside the Advent bustle.

name: Christmas Market Photoshoot
description: A private photographer accompanies you through a Christmas market, catching festive portraits against the fairy lights.

name: Candle-Making Workshop with Prosecco
description: Pour, scent and decorate your own candles in a hands-on workshop with a glass of Prosecco on the side - gifts ready by hand.

name: Private Christmas Pottery Workshop
description: Hand-build festive ceramics across two hours, mulled wine in hand, in a small-group studio session.

name: studio32 Christmas Cooking Class
description: Four hours cooking and baking a festive menu with a local host, and leaving with dishes worth a gift wrap.

name: Christmas with Bibi & Tina - The Musical
description: Berlin's winter season with the horse-mad TV favourite: a three-hour family musical staging.
